name_en: Izushi — fish and rice pickled with koji
summary_ja: 魚と野菜を米麹に漬け、低温でじっくり乳酸発酵させるなれずし。ニシンやホッケ、サケなど北海道でとれる魚を使い、晩秋に漬け込んで正月ごろに食べる冬の保存食と伝わる。
summary_en: Fish and vegetables are packed with rice malt and left to ferment slowly at low temperature — a narezushi made with herring, atka mackerel, or salmon, said to be pickled in late autumn and eaten around New Year's.
source_title: 飯寿司 北海道 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
